text: The upload token audience is set by the audiencePrefix config property.
The rdbms schema CLI only prints a message when postgres dbUser or dbPassword is missing and keeps running with empty credentials.
The JAX-RS address comes from the applicationPath entry of Application.getProperties(), not from the OSGi service property.
Keycloak admin user defaults to admin; keycloakPassword defaults to judo (JUDO_PLATFORM_KEYCLOAK_USER / _PASSWORD).
judo.sh prune prints [Y/n] but only an exact 'Y' continues; Enter and 'y' abort.
Add to the prune safety section: "The `[Y/n]` prompt continues only for an exact `Y`; Enter, `y` and any other input abort."
